title: Student opportunity action centre
objective: Allow the learner to save, show interest, start application, mark applied/completed, and view saved actions.
guardrails: Prototype uses anonymous local learner key and no free-text notes. Client event IDs make retries idempotent within the current in-memory store.
exitCriteria: User can save or update an action locally, view it in Saved Items, and sync it to the Java API when online.
prototypeBoundary: This phase uses the Phase 09–17 prototype contracts. Database persistence and production auth are not claimed.
